lines.zh: 盾牌随我一起转，像四扇门。
lines.en: My shields turn with me, four doors of flame.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草自己烧起来。
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass catches fire.
My flame legs land with a hiss.
I walk slowly; I need not hurry.
Four shields clear the way; I follow.
Every step bakes the ground dry.
A heat wave rolls the dust ahead of me.
I walk along the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 影子在我脚下烧成一条线。
lines.en: My shadow burns into a line beneath me.
As I near, the air turns hot first.

lines.zh: 我在听火焰自己的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sound of my own fire.
Four shields hang and slowly turn.
This hall was mine to begin with.
Fire needs no rest; I do.
I count how many kin remain.
The lava below keeps bubbling.
Before visitors come, it is quiet here.
My crown is missing a corner.

lines.zh: 火焰里没有影子，只有热。
lines.en: In flame there is no shadow, only heat.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得站起来的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone worth standing for.
More cracks have appeared on the shields.

lines.zh: 这里的地砖被我烤裂了。
lines.en: The floor tiles are cracked from my heat.
I never go out; the door is too narrow.
I close my eyes; the fire stays lit.
The shields are brighter than yesterday.
I count the echoes in the hall.

lines.zh: 你的火把只照到我的盾沿。
lines.en: Your torch reaches only the rim of my shields.

lines.zh: 我数你盔甲上的缝，一共七道。
lines.en: I count the seams in your armor: seven of them.

lines.zh: 这么小的人，也敢闯进来。
lines.en: So small a creature dares come in.

lines.zh: 我数你的装备，一件件数。
lines.en: I count your gear, piece by piece.
Can that armor hold off heat?
I see fire reflected in your eyes.
You do not kneel; I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在门口没进来。
lines.en: Your companion stayed at the doorway.
Have you looked up long enough?

lines.zh: 我低头，火焰垂到你面前。
lines.en: I lean down; flame hangs before your face.
Your breathing has quickened.

lines.zh: 你已经算走进我的火里了。
lines.en: You have already stepped into my fire.
A shield has shattered.
You landed a hit; that's not easy.
A gash cut through my flame.
I step back; the floor cracks.
The fire will mend this little wound.
My crown is askew.
You struck the seam between my shields.
Pain? Flame has no such word.
Ash falls and blinds my eyes.
I will remember that blade.
Gold? Fire does not eat gold.

lines.zh: 我什么都不缺，除了对手。
lines.en: I lack nothing but a worthy rival.

lines.zh: 你的食物在这儿会烧成灰。
lines.en: Your food turns to ash here.

lines.zh: 别举着东西哄我，像哄小孩。
lines.en: Don't wave things at me as at a child.

lines.zh: 我的火只认燃料，不认礼物。
lines.en: My fire knows fuel, not gifts.

lines.zh: 你把礼物放下，它自己会烧。
lines.en: Set your gift down; it will burn itself.

lines.zh: 想让我安静？拿水来试试。
lines.en: Want me quiet? Try bringing water.

lines.zh: 我不收买人心，也不收买火。
lines.en: I buy neither loyalty nor flame.
This iron feels cold; move it away.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我只想烧。
lines.en: All I want from your hands is to burn it.
You hit a shield and bounced back.
My shield is harder than your body.
Don't press so close; you'll burn.

lines.zh: 我退了一步？不，是地裂了。
lines.en: Did I step back? No — the floor cracked.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲撞出一串火星。
lines.en: Your armor struck a spray of sparks.
All four shields close at once.

lines.zh: 我被撞得晃了一下，仅此。
lines.en: I swayed once — that's all.
My four shields knock you back.

lines.zh: 站远点，我脚下没有余地。
lines.en: Stand back; there is no room at my feet.
The nerve to charge me is impressive.

lines.zh: 火焰的伴侣只会互相吞噬。
lines.en: Flame's consorts would only devour each other.

lines.zh: 我是烈焰人的首领，不是新郎。
lines.en: I am the blazes' leader, not a groom.
Stand beside me? Step into the fire first.
One throne, and it is wide enough.

lines.zh: 我召来的是士兵，不是家人。
lines.en: I summon soldiers, not family.
Fire and I were always one.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是没别的话了吗？
lines.en: You ask that because you have nothing else?

lines.zh: 我的同类只会争谁的火烧得高。
lines.en: My kin only argue whose flame burns higher.

lines.zh: 伴侣？火里只长出更多的火。
lines.en: A mate? Fire only grows more fire.
Survive this fight first, then we'll talk.
I don't pick things up; I burn them.
That iron fell; nothing to do with me.
Pick it up quickly; the floor is hot.

lines.zh: 我手上没有拿东西的地方。
lines.en: My hands have no room for carrying.

lines.zh: 掉下来的碎片自然归火。
lines.en: Fallen shards belong to the fire.

lines.zh: 我不需要战利品，我需要臣服。
lines.en: I need no loot; I need submission.
Bend down? I do not bend.
Let it burn; that counts as accepting it.

lines.zh: 我的东西只有王冠和盾。
lines.en: My only things are crown and shields.
What lies here is left for the fire to come.
Weight at the doorway; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 又一个挑战者走进大厅。
lines.en: Another challenger steps into my hall.

lines.zh: 你踩上第一块砖，我就知道。
lines.en: You step on the first tile; I know.
Four shields turn toward you at once.
I have waited a long time for this fight.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在厅里太大了。
lines.en: Your footsteps are too loud in this hall.

lines.zh: 火焰往你那边偏了一寸。
lines.en: My flame leans an inch toward you.

lines.zh: 有人想拿走我的王冠碎片。
lines.en: Someone wants my crown shard.

lines.zh: 这种眼神，我见过很多次。
lines.en: That look — I've seen it many times.

lines.zh: 你带了几个人，我数清了。
lines.en: I've counted how many you brought.
The fire moves first; then I do.
This floor answers to me.
The door is shut; don't look back.

lines.zh: 你要的是碎片，我要的是你站着。
lines.en: You want a shard; I want you standing.
The chain on the door rattled.
Your shadow fell on the fire first.
I lift my head and the flames stand.
Four ways, four of you. Enough.
I circle you; the fire forms a ring.

lines.zh: 盾牌在半空分开，量你的距离。
lines.en: The shields spread, measuring your distance.
You dodge left; I press left.
My shards are already sharpened.

lines.zh: 你数我的盾，我也在数你。
lines.en: You count my shields; I count you.
Don't stand on that crack.
I wait for your arrows to run out.

lines.zh: 你换武器的声音我听见了。
lines.en: I heard you swap weapons.
The closer you come, the harder retreat is.
I raise my hand; you start running.

lines.zh: 大厅的四个角我都封了。
lines.en: All four corners of the hall are sealed.

lines.zh: 你的火把在我这里没用。
lines.en: Your torch is useless here.

lines.zh: 我在等你喘气的那一秒。
lines.en: I am waiting for the second you gasp.
I've already calculated this strike.
I push one shield to the left.
You hide. I count to two.
The shards stop circling and charge.
I bank the fire low to hide in smoke.

lines.zh: 你的弓拉满了，我等那放。
lines.en: Your bow is full. I wait for the loose.
Before the quake, I raise my foot.

lines.zh: 我砸下去，地面凹了一块。
lines.en: I slam down; the floor dents.

lines.zh: 八点伤害，你撑不了几次。
lines.en: Eight points of damage — you can't take many.
Shards fly off all four shields.
This fist carries fire.

lines.zh: 地面裂开，冲击波追着你。
lines.en: The ground splits; the shockwave chases you.
You blocked; your arm is already scorched.

lines.zh: 我不用追，我的碎片会追。
lines.en: I don't chase; my shards do.
That one was a lesson.
I strike slowly, but every blow is heavy.
Your armor is dented.

lines.zh: 我抬手，火顺着地面爬过去。
lines.en: I raise a hand; fire crawls along the floor.
Shards return to the shields; it's not over.
You've backed into the corner; good.

lines.zh: 这一击是为了被烧掉的同类。
lines.en: This blow is for the kin you burned.

lines.zh: 大厅中央的火柱散开了。
lines.en: The fire pillar in the hall's center opens.

lines.zh: 我从火里站起来，先看见盾。
lines.en: I rise from flame and see shields first.
Four shields fan out around me.

lines.zh: 王座下有人在喊我的名字。
lines.en: Someone below the throne calls my name.
My fire lights the whole fortress.

lines.zh: 我来了，这里就该热起来。
lines.en: I'm here; this place should grow hot.
The crown sits heavy on my head.
The lava beneath my feet wakes.

lines.zh: 我是烈焰人的首领，别弄错。
lines.en: I lead the blazes; don't mistake that.
New challenger, new ash.
This floor belongs to me henceforth.

lines.zh: 火焰一层层叠上我的肩。
lines.en: Flame layers up over my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，墙上的火把全灭了。
lines.en: I open my eyes; every torch dies.
Who dares take the first step?

lines.zh: 这座大厅的封印是我开的。
lines.en: I opened this hall's seal myself.
I light the throne, then rise.

lines.zh: 火从地砖缝里冒出来找我。
lines.en: Fire climbs out of the tiles to me.

lines.zh: 我的骨架在火里重新拼好。
lines.en: My frame reassembles in the flame.

lines.zh: 盾牌飞回来，围成四面墙。
lines.en: The shields return as four walls.

lines.zh: 我一开口，火就烧得更旺。
lines.en: I speak, and the fire grows.

lines.zh: 我生在火里，你拿火烧我？
lines.en: I was born in fire — you'd burn me with fire?

lines.zh: 我落地，震得砖都跳起来。
lines.en: I hit the ground; the tiles jump.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，我的火矮了半截。
lines.en: Water hits; my flame drops by half.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的盾掀翻了一片。
lines.en: The blast flipped one of my shields.
The arrow pierced flame and stuck in a shield.
A potion splashed; my fire changed color.
I live on fire, not on bread.

lines.zh: 雷落在盾上，四片一起响。
lines.en: Lightning struck a shield; all four rang.
The bridge broke; I fell into the blank.
